resources.string: See yourself move in new clothes.
1. Make a video of yourself, up to 10 seconds, head to feet. Move slowly: turn, raise an arm, take a step.\n2. Choose a top, a bottom or both.\n3. Wait a few minutes while it is dressed.
Front camera. A spoken countdown gives you time to step back.
Up to 10 seconds, with all of you in the picture.
